SELECT / CUSTOMIZE / APPROVE

Choose a buying guide for your product

Use the guides below for custom dimensions, logo placement and lighting decisions. Each guide connects the question to current model references and a project enquiry.

Custom collapsible cups ↗Custom coasters with logo ↗Custom bottle & wine openers ↗LED customization & production ↗

Ordering, artwork and delivery questions

Most questions come down to four things: the model, the quantity, the artwork and the delivery scope. Sending all four makes the first reply actionable.

How fast can I get a quote?

Share the model, quantity, artwork and delivery scope — the quote is prepared after review.

Can you match a colour?

Colour matching is discussed against a reference and the selected material, then confirmed on a sample.

Do you ship to the United States?

Delivery scope, trade terms and schedule are confirmed in the quotation for each project.

Pricing, setup fees and mould costs

Unit price moves with quantity, because print setup and machine time are spread across the run. There is no single price list for logo printing: send the model, quantity, artwork and delivery scope and the quotation comes back with the actual figure. Setup and screen charges are quoted per artwork and per colour. For a custom shape, tooling is quoted separately from unit price — it is not bundled into the piece price.

Importing drinkware from China and choosing a supplier

Most buyers ship by sea for bulk and by air for launches. DDP (delivered duty paid) means the supplier handles freight, duty and delivery to your address; FOB means you take over at the port. When comparing suppliers, check three things: whether they actually mould and print in-house, which material and food contact documents they can produce, and whether they will confirm limits in writing rather than by verbal assurance.

How much does it cost to print a logo on cups?

It depends on the model, quantity, print method and number of colours. Send those four and the quotation comes back with the actual figure rather than an estimate.

Are there setup fees for custom printed cups?

Setup and screen charges are quoted per artwork and per colour, and are listed separately in the quote.

Are mould costs included for custom shaped cups?

Tooling for a custom shape is quoted separately from the unit price. It is not bundled into the piece price.

How does quantity affect the price per cup?

Setup and machine time are spread across the run, so unit price falls as quantity rises. The steps are shown in the quotation for your model.

How do I import custom drinkware from China?

Choose the trade term first: DDP means the supplier handles freight, duty and delivery to your address; FOB means you take over at the port. Then confirm documents, packing and lead time in writing.

How do I choose a custom drinkware supplier in China?

Check three things: whether they mould and print in-house, which food-contact and material documents they can produce, and whether they confirm limits in writing.

What is the cheapest way to print cups with a logo?

Screen printing with fewer colours is usually the most economical for flat or tapered plastic walls. Confirm the artwork and surface first, because curved or textured surfaces change the method.

选型 · 定制 · 确认

按产品选择采购指南

以下指南帮助核对定制尺寸、Logo 位置及灯效，并关联当前型号与项目询价。

定制折叠杯 ↗定制 Logo 杯垫 ↗定制瓶盖与红酒开瓶器 ↗LED 定制与生产流程 ↗

下单、图稿与交付问题

多数问题归结为四点：型号、数量、图稿和交付范围。四项一起提供，第一次回复就能直接进入报价。

多久能拿到报价？

提供型号、数量、图稿和交付范围后，我们在审核项目后准备报价。

颜色可以对照吗？

颜色对照按参考色和所选材料沟通，再在样品上确认。

可以发到美国吗？

交付范围、贸易条款和进度在每个项目的报价中确认。

价格、版费与开模费

单价随数量变化，因为印刷开机和机时摊薄在整批订单上。Logo 印刷没有统一价目表：提供型号、数量、图稿和交付范围后，报价会给出实际数字。制版与网版费按图稿和颜色数单列。定制异形时，模具费与单价分开报价，不含在单件价里。

从中国进口酒具与供应商选择

多数买家批量走海运，上市急货走空运。DDP（完税交货）指供应商负责运费、关税并送到您的地址；FOB 指您在港口接货。比较供应商时看三点：是否自有注塑和印刷、能否提供材料与食品接触文件、是否愿意把限制条件写进书面确认。

在杯子上印 Logo 要多少钱？

取决于型号、数量、印刷工艺和颜色数。提供这四项后，报价给出实际数字，不做估算。

定制印刷杯有版费吗？

制版与网版费按图稿和颜色数报价，在报价单中单列。

定制异形杯的模具费含在单价里吗？

异形开模的模具费与单价分开报价，不含在单件价格里。

数量如何影响单只杯子的价格？

开机与机时摊薄在整批订单上，数量越大单价越低。报价单会按您的型号列出阶梯。

从中国进口定制酒具怎么操作？

先定贸易条款：DDP 指供应商负责运费、关税并送到您的地址；FOB 指您在港口接货。然后把文件、包装和交期写进书面确认。

怎么挑选中国的定制酒具供应商？

看三点：是否自有注塑和印刷、能否提供材料与食品接触文件、是否愿意把限制条件写进书面确认。

带 Logo 的杯子最便宜的印刷方式是什么？

颜色少的丝印在平面或微斜的塑料杯壁上通常最经济。先确认图稿与表面，弧面或纹理面会改变工艺选择。

Home / Custom Drinkware Buying FAQ

BOOM Drinkware / BUYING & CUSTOMIZATION

Custom Drinkware Buying FAQ

Answers about models, small batches, samples, new tooling, artwork, packaging and delivery planning.

Request a Project Quote ↗Explore Product Models

BUYER QUESTIONS

Clear answers before the next step.

Can I enquire before choosing a model?

Yes. Describe the intended use, quantity and arrival date; add a reference or drawing if available.

What determines MOQ and lead time?

The model, materials, design versions, decoration, packaging and tooling affect the proposal. Small batches from 10 pieces and fast sampling apply to eligible projects; confirm the conditions in your quote.

What should my enquiry include?

A model or product idea, quantity, artwork, pack contents, destination and required arrival date are a useful start.

Do you offer OEM and ODM work?

Discuss existing-model customization, manufacturing to your design or development support. Agree design work, tooling ownership, costs and scope in the project.

Can sampling take one day?

Eligible sampling can be as fast as one day. Confirm sample type and artwork approval; new structures or molds require a separate schedule.

Is 7–10 day delivery available?

Discuss the destination, order readiness and shipping option. Confirm the quoted start point, scope and whether production is included.

Are all samples free?

No universal free-sample offer is stated. Sample, decoration, tooling and freight costs should be confirmed for the project.

Can I compare models?

Yes. Select up to three models on product pages, open the comparison and carry the shortlist into one enquiry.

YOUR NEXT STEP

Let’s make your project specific.

Share the model or idea, quantity, artwork, destination and arrival date. You can add files in the project enquiry.

Request a Project Quote ↗

首页 / 杯具定制采购常见问题

BOOM Drinkware / 采购与定制

杯具定制采购常见问题

了解型号、小批量、样品、新模具、图稿、包装与交付规划。

提交项目询价 ↗浏览产品型号

采购常见问题

下一步之前，先说明白。

还没选定型号，可以询价吗？

可以。说明用途、数量和到货日期，有参考图或图纸可一并提供。

起订量与交期由什么决定？

型号、材料、图稿版本、装饰、包装与模具都会影响方案。10 件起及快速打样适用于相应项目，条件需在报价中确认。

询价需要提供什么？

型号或产品想法、数量、图稿、包装组成、目的地及期望到货日期，是有效的起点。

支持 OEM 与 ODM 吗？

可沟通现有款定制、按图制造或开发支持，设计工作、模具归属、费用及范围按项目约定。

样品制作需要多久？

样品通常在图纸确认后3–5天制作完成。新结构或新模具项目的模具环节及整体排期另行确认。

可以 7–10 天交付吗？

需结合目的地、备货状态与运输方式评估，并确认报价的起算点、范围及是否包含生产。

所有样品都免费吗？

不统一承诺免费样品，样品、装饰、模具及运输费用需按项目确认。

可以比较型号吗？

可以。在产品页选择最多 3 个型号，展开比较后将清单一起带入询价。

下一步

一起把项目需求明确下来。

提供型号或想法、数量、图稿、目的地及到货日期，可在询价中添加文件。

提交项目询价 ↗
